```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(datenanpassr)
filepath <- system.file("extdata", "mapping_xlsm.xlsx", package = "datenanpassr")
```

```{r}
mapping_file <- system.file("extdata", "mapping_xlsm.xlsx", package = "datenanpassr")
spss_file <- system.file("extdata", "fake_survey.sav", package = "datenanpassr")
bm <- bench::mark(datenanpassr::Mapping$new(spss_file, mapping_file, translate_xlsm = TRUE), min_iterations = 7)
print(bm, width = 11111)
```
